items.source: locale - the locale in which to do the lookup
items.translation: locale - 执行查找的本地化环境

items.source: NOTE: We must throw a NoSuchMessageException on this method since at the time of calling this method we aren't able to determine if the defaultMessage property of the resolvable is null or not.
items.translation: NOTE: 我们必须在该方法上抛出 NoSuchMessageException，因为在调用此方法时，我们无法确定可解析对象的 defaultMessage 属性是否为 null。

items.source: Spring provides two out-of-the-box implementations for production:
items.translation: Spring 为生产环境提供了两种开箱即用的实现：

items.source: Try to resolve the message. Return default message if no message was found.
items.translation: 尝试解析该消息。如果未找到消息，则返回默认消息。

items.source: Try to resolve the message. Treat as an error if the message can't be found.
items.translation: 尝试解析该消息。如果找不到该消息，则将其视为错误。

items.source: ResourceBundleMessageSource: built on top of the standard ResourceBundle, sharing its limitations.
items.translation: ResourceBundleMessageSource：构建于标准 ResourceBundle 之上，共享其局限性。

items.source: NoSuchMessageException - if no corresponding message was found (and no default message was provided by the MessageSourceResolvable)
items.translation: NoSuchMessageException - 如果未找到对应的消息（且 MessageSourceResolvable 未提供默认消息）

items.source: ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource: highly configurable, in particular with respect to reloading message definitions.
items.translation: ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource：高度可配置，特别是关于重新加载消息定义方面。

items.source: args - an array of arguments that will be filled in for params within the message (params look like "{0}", "{1,date}", "{2,time}" within a message), or null if none
items.translation: `args` - 一个数组，其中包含要在消息中的参数内填充的实参（在消息中，参数看起来像"{0}"、"{1,date}"、"{2,time}"），或者如果没有则为 `null`。

items.source: NoSuchMessageException - if no corresponding message was found
items.translation: NoSuchMessageException - 如果未找到相应的消息

items.source: the resolved message (never null since even a MessageSourceResolvable-provided default message needs to be non-null)
items.translation: 已解析的消息（永远不会为 `null`，因为即使是由 `MessageSourceResolvable` 提供的默认消息也必须是非空的）

items.source: code - the message code to look up, for example, 'calculator.noRateSet'. MessageSource users are encouraged to base message names on qualified class or package names, avoiding potential conflicts and ensuring maximum clarity.
items.translation: `code` - 要查找的消息代码，例如 'calculator.noRateSet'。建议 MessageSource 用户基于限定类名或包名来构建消息名称，以避免潜在的冲突并确保最大清晰度。

items.source: defaultMessage - a default message to return if the lookup fails
items.translation: defaultMessage - 如果查找失败则返回的默认消息

items.source: the resolved message if the lookup was successful, otherwise the default message passed as a parameter (which may be null)
items.translation: 如果查找成功，则返回解析后的消息；否则，返回作为参数传递的默认消息（该消息可能为 `null`）。
已解析的消息（永远不为null）

items.source: resolvable - the value object storing attributes required to resolve a message (may include a default message)
items.translation: resolvable - 存储解析消息所需属性的值对象（可能包含默认消息）

items.source: Try to resolve the message using all the attributes contained within the MessageSourceResolvable argument that was passed in.
items.translation: 尝试使用传入的 `MessageSourceResolvable` 参数中包含的所有属性来解析该消息。
